errors.evidence: In Test5, the WER value for the "无" category is approximately 31%, not 32%. The bar is clearly just above the 30% line and lower than the i-vector bar in Test2 which is at 32%.

errors.text_span: 在每个测试集中，四根柱子的WER值均有所不同。
errors.evidence: This statement claims that the four bars have different WER values in each test set. However, in Test1, the values for "d-vector" and "s-vector" are both approximately 30%. In Test2, they are also approximately the same height. Therefore, it is not true that the values are different in every test set.
